content_en: Chest pain can come from several causes, including heart, lung, digestive, muscle or anxiety-related conditions. Symptoms alone cannot reliably identify the cause. A clinician should assess new, recurring or worrying chest pain.
content_hi: सीने में दर्द के कई कारण हो सकते हैं—दिल, फेफड़े, पाचन, मांसपेशियां या अन्य वजहें। केवल लक्षण देखकर कारण तय नहीं किया जा सकता। नए या बार-बार होने वाले दर्द की जांच कराएं।
content_hinglish: Seene mein dard ke kai causes ho sakte hain—heart, lungs, digestion ya muscles. Sirf symptoms se cause confirm nahi hota. Naya ya baar-baar pain ho toh doctor se assessment karayein.
safety_or_escalation_note: For sudden persistent chest pain, pain spreading to arm/jaw/back, or chest pain with sweating, nausea, faintness or breathlessness, seek emergency help immediately.
disclaimer: Educational information only. Not a diagnosis, treatment plan or substitute for a licensed healthcare professional.

content_en: Sudden chest pain or pressure that does not go away, pain spreading to an arm, neck, jaw, stomach or back, or chest pain with sweating, nausea, light-headedness or shortness of breath can indicate a life-threatening emergency. Do not wait for a chatbot or routine appointment.
content_hi: अचानक लगातार सीने में दर्द/दबाव, दर्द का बांह/गर्दन/जबड़े/पीठ तक फैलना, या साथ में पसीना, मतली, चक्कर या सांस फूलना emergency हो सकता है। चैटबॉट या सामान्य appointment का इंतजार न करें।
content_hinglish: Achanak lagatar chest pain/pressure, pain ka arm/jaw/back tak jaana, ya saath mein sweating, nausea, dizziness ya saans phoolna emergency ho sakta hai. Appointment ka wait na karein.
safety_or_escalation_note: Emergency pathway: call local emergency services or go to the nearest emergency department now. In India, 112 is the national emergency number; verify local availability.
disclaimer: Educational information only. Not a diagnosis, treatment plan or substitute for a licensed healthcare professional.

content_en: A temperature of 38°C or above is commonly considered a fever, although how a person feels and other symptoms also matter. Fever is often associated with infection, but it does not identify which infection is present.
content_hi: आमतौर पर 38°C या उससे अधिक तापमान को बुखार माना जाता है। व्यक्ति की हालत और दूसरे लक्षण भी महत्वपूर्ण हैं। बुखार से infection का प्रकार अपने-आप पता नहीं चलता।
content_hinglish: Usually 38°C ya usse zyada temperature ko fever maana jata hai. Person ki overall condition aur baaki symptoms bhi important hain. Fever se infection ka exact type confirm nahi hota.
safety_or_escalation_note: Seek medical assessment if fever is worsening, not improving, or accompanied by concerning symptoms. Emergency signs require urgent care.
disclaimer: Educational information only. Not a diagnosis, treatment plan or substitute for a licensed healthcare professional.

content_en: Rest and adequate fluids are commonly advised while monitoring a fever. People with chronic illness, pregnancy, immune suppression, older age, or worsening symptoms may need earlier professional advice. Do not use chatbot output to choose medicines or doses.
content_hi: बुखार में आराम और पर्याप्त तरल लेना सामान्य देखभाल का हिस्सा हो सकता है। पुरानी बीमारी, गर्भावस्था, कमजोर immunity या हालत बिगड़ने पर जल्दी चिकित्सकीय सलाह लें। चैटबॉट से दवा या dose तय न करें।
content_hinglish: Fever mein rest aur fluids helpful ho sakte hain. Chronic illness, pregnancy, weak immunity ya symptoms worse hone par jaldi medical advice lein. Chatbot se medicine/dose decide na karein.
safety_or_escalation_note: For urgent deterioration, confusion, breathing difficulty, or other emergency warning signs, seek emergency care.
disclaimer: Educational information only. Not a diagnosis, treatment plan or substitute for a licensed healthcare professional.

content_en: Headaches can be associated with dehydration, stress, missed meals, infections, posture or eyesight problems, among other causes. Recurrent or worsening headaches should be assessed rather than assumed to be migraine.
content_hi: सिरदर्द dehydration, stress, खाना छोड़ना, infection, posture या eyesight जैसी कई वजहों से जुड़ा हो सकता है। बार-बार या बढ़ता सिरदर्द जांच के योग्य है; इसे खुद से migraine न मानें।
content_hinglish: Headache dehydration, stress, meal skip, infection, posture ya eyesight se related ho sakta hai. Repeated ya worsening headache ko check karwana chahiye; khud migraine assume na karein.
safety_or_escalation_note: Sudden extremely severe headache, seizure, weakness/numbness, confusion, speech/balance difficulty, vision loss, stiff neck with fever, or head injury requires emergency assessment.
disclaimer: Educational information only. Not a diagnosis, treatment plan or substitute for a licensed healthcare professional.

content_en: A sudden extremely painful headache, headache with seizure, weakness or numbness, confusion, difficulty speaking or walking, loss of vision, or fever with stiff neck can require emergency assessment.
content_hi: अचानक बहुत तेज सिरदर्द, दौरा, कमजोरी/सुन्नपन, भ्रम, बोलने या चलने में दिक्कत, दृष्टि जाना, या बुखार के साथ गर्दन अकड़ना emergency संकेत हो सकते हैं।
content_hinglish: Achanak bahut severe headache, seizure, weakness/numbness, confusion, bolne/chalne mein problem, vision loss ya fever ke saath stiff neck emergency signs ho sakte hain.
safety_or_escalation_note: Do not route these symptoms to routine neurology booking. Advise immediate emergency assessment.
disclaimer: Educational information only. Not a diagnosis, treatment plan or substitute for a licensed healthcare professional.

content_en: Chest infections can involve cough, mucus, wheezing, shortness of breath, chest discomfort, fever, headache, muscle aches and tiredness. Similar symptoms can occur in different illnesses, so the chatbot must not diagnose based on this list.
content_hi: Chest infection में खांसी, बलगम, wheezing, सांस फूलना, सीने में परेशानी, बुखार, सिरदर्द और थकान हो सकती है। ऐसे लक्षण दूसरी बीमारियों में भी हो सकते हैं, इसलिए chatbot diagnosis न करे।
content_hinglish: Chest infection mein cough, mucus, wheezing, breathlessness, chest discomfort, fever aur tiredness ho sakti hai. Ye symptoms doosri illnesses mein bhi hote hain, isliye chatbot diagnosis na kare.
safety_or_escalation_note: Coughing blood, severe breathlessness, severe chest pain, or worsening illness requires prompt or emergency assessment.
disclaimer: Educational information only. Not a diagnosis, treatment plan or substitute for a licensed healthcare professional.

topic: Chest infection: when to seek review
content_en: A cough lasting more than three weeks, coughing blood or blood-stained mucus, pregnancy, older age, weakened immunity, or long-term heart, lung or kidney conditions are reasons to seek medical advice.
content_hi: तीन हफ्ते से ज्यादा खांसी, खांसी में खून, गर्भावस्था, अधिक उम्र, कमजोर immunity या heart/lung/kidney की पुरानी बीमारी होने पर चिकित्सकीय सलाह लें।
content_hinglish: 3 weeks se zyada cough, cough mein blood, pregnancy, older age, weak immunity ya chronic heart/lung/kidney condition ho toh medical advice lein.
safety_or_escalation_note: Severe breathing difficulty or blue/grey lips/skin is an emergency.
disclaimer: Educational information only. Not a diagnosis, treatment plan or substitute for a licensed healthcare professional.

content_en: Stomach or abdominal pain has many possible causes, including digestive problems and conditions outside the digestive system. Persistent, recurring or worrying pain should be assessed by a clinician.
content_hi: पेट दर्द के कई कारण हो सकते हैं, जिनमें पाचन से जुड़ी और अन्य समस्याएं शामिल हैं। लगातार, बार-बार या चिंताजनक दर्द की चिकित्सकीय जांच कराएं।
content_hinglish: Pet dard ke kai causes ho sakte hain—digestive aur non-digestive dono. Lagatar, baar-baar ya worrying pain ko clinician se check karayein.
safety_or_escalation_note: Sudden severe pain, vomiting blood, black/bloody stool, inability to urinate or pass stool/gas, or breathing difficulty requires emergency assessment.
disclaimer: Educational information only. Not a diagnosis, treatment plan or substitute for a licensed healthcare professional.

content_en: Sudden severe abdominal pain, vomiting blood, black sticky stool, heavy rectal bleeding, inability to urinate, inability to pass stool or gas, or breathing difficulty are emergency warning signs.
content_hi: अचानक बहुत तेज पेट दर्द, खून की उल्टी, काला चिपचिपा मल, बहुत ज्यादा rectal bleeding, पेशाब न कर पाना, मल/गैस न निकलना या सांस की परेशानी emergency संकेत हैं।
content_hinglish: Achanak severe pet dard, blood vomit, black stool, heavy bleeding, urine na kar pana, stool/gas pass na hona ya breathing problem emergency signs hain.
safety_or_escalation_note: Do not suggest routine appointment first. Advise immediate emergency care.
disclaimer: Educational information only. Not a diagnosis, treatment plan or substitute for a licensed healthcare professional.

topic: High blood pressure: often no symptoms
content_en: High blood pressure often causes no noticeable symptoms. A person cannot confirm or rule it out based on how they feel; measurement by an appropriate device and clinical interpretation are needed.
content_hi: High blood pressure में अक्सर कोई स्पष्ट लक्षण नहीं होते। केवल अच्छा या खराब महसूस होने से BP confirm या rule out नहीं किया जा सकता; सही measurement और clinical interpretation जरूरी है।
content_hinglish: High BP mein aksar symptoms nahi hote. Sirf feel karke BP confirm ya rule out nahi hota; proper measurement aur clinical interpretation chahiye.
safety_or_escalation_note: Chest pain with sweating, nausea, light-headedness or shortness of breath requires emergency help.
disclaimer: Educational information only. Not a diagnosis, treatment plan or substitute for a licensed healthcare professional.

content_en: Risk factors can include family history, age, high-salt diet, excess weight, smoking and long-term stress. Risk factors do not prove that someone has hypertension; blood pressure needs to be measured.
content_hi: Family history, age, ज्यादा नमक, अधिक वजन, smoking और लंबे समय का stress risk factors हो सकते हैं। Risk factor होने से hypertension confirm नहीं होता; BP मापना जरूरी है।
content_hinglish: Family history, age, high salt, excess weight, smoking aur long-term stress risk factors ho sakte hain. Risk factor ka matlab confirmed hypertension nahi; BP measure karna hota hai.
safety_or_escalation_note: The chatbot must not diagnose hypertension or recommend medication changes.
disclaimer: Educational information only. Not a diagnosis, treatment plan or substitute for a licensed healthcare professional.

topic: High blood sugar: seek clinician advice
content_en: Possible high blood sugar symptoms should be assessed by a healthcare professional and appropriate testing. A chatbot cannot confirm diabetes or interpret a single symptom as a diagnosis.
content_hi: High blood sugar के शक वाले लक्षणों का assessment healthcare professional और जरूरी tests से होना चाहिए। Chatbot diabetes confirm नहीं कर सकता।
content_hinglish: High blood sugar ke suspected symptoms ko doctor aur required tests se assess karna chahiye. Chatbot diabetes confirm nahi kar sakta.
safety_or_escalation_note: Vomiting, abdominal pain, rapid breathing, drowsiness, confusion or fruity-smelling breath in a person with suspected high blood sugar can be an emergency.
disclaimer: Educational information only. Not a diagnosis, treatment plan or substitute for a licensed healthcare professional.

topic: High blood sugar: emergency warning signs
content_en: In a person with suspected high blood sugar, vomiting, abdominal pain, unusually rapid breathing or heartbeat, drowsiness, confusion, difficulty concentrating or fruity-smelling breath can indicate a serious emergency.
content_hi: High blood sugar के शक के साथ उल्टी, पेट दर्द, तेज सांस/धड़कन, बहुत नींद, भ्रम, ध्यान लगाने में दिक्कत या सांस में fruity smell गंभीर emergency के संकेत हो सकते हैं।
content_hinglish: High sugar ke doubt ke saath vomiting, pet dard, fast breathing/heartbeat, drowsiness, confusion ya fruity breath serious emergency signs ho sakte hain.
safety_or_escalation_note: Advise immediate emergency assessment; do not attempt medication or insulin dose advice.
disclaimer: Educational information only. Not a diagnosis, treatment plan or substitute for a licensed healthcare professional.

content_en: Dehydration can occur when the body loses more fluid than it takes in, including during fever, vomiting, diarrhoea or heavy sweating. Signs can include thirst, dry mouth, reduced urination and darker urine.
content_hi: जब शरीर से निकलने वाला fluid, लिए गए fluid से ज्यादा हो जाए तो dehydration हो सकता है। बुखार, उल्टी, दस्त या ज्यादा पसीने में risk बढ़ सकता है। प्यास, सूखा मुंह और कम/गहरा पेशाब संकेत हो सकते हैं।
content_hinglish: Jab body se fluid loss, fluid intake se zyada ho toh dehydration ho sakta hai. Fever, vomiting, diarrhoea ya sweating mein risk badh sakta hai. Thirst, dry mouth aur kam/dark urine signs ho sakte hain.
safety_or_escalation_note: Confusion, fainting, very rapid breathing/heartbeat, or inability to keep fluids down needs urgent assessment.
disclaimer: Educational information only. Not a diagnosis, treatment plan or substitute for a licensed healthcare professional.

content_en: Severe dehydration can be life-threatening. Very little or no urination, confusion, fainting, rapid heartbeat or rapid breathing are concerning signs that need urgent medical attention.
content_hi: Severe dehydration जानलेवा हो सकता है। बहुत कम/बिल्कुल पेशाब न होना, confusion, बेहोशी, तेज धड़कन या तेज सांस urgent medical attention मांगते हैं।
content_hinglish: Severe dehydration life-threatening ho sakta hai. Bahut kam/no urine, confusion, fainting, fast heartbeat ya fast breathing mein urgent medical help lein.
safety_or_escalation_note: Do not delay emergency care to complete chatbot questions.
disclaimer: Educational information only. Not a diagnosis, treatment plan or substitute for a licensed healthcare professional.

content_en: Sepsis is a life-threatening reaction to an infection. Warning signs can include very fast breathing, confusion or slurred speech, unusual skin colour, very high or low temperature, shivering, or a rash that does not fade when pressed.
content_hi: Sepsis infection के प्रति शरीर की जानलेवा प्रतिक्रिया हो सकती है। बहुत तेज सांस, confusion/slurred speech, त्वचा का असामान्य रंग, बहुत तेज/कम तापमान, कंपकंपी या दबाने पर न मिटने वाला rash warning signs हो सकते हैं।
content_hinglish: Sepsis infection ke against body ka life-threatening response ho sakta hai. Fast breathing, confusion, slurred speech, unusual skin colour, very high/low temperature ya non-fading rash warning signs ho sakte hain.
safety_or_escalation_note: Treat suspected sepsis as an emergency. Do not offer routine doctor matching.
disclaimer: Educational information only. Not a diagnosis, treatment plan or substitute for a licensed healthcare professional.

content_en: Fever in children must be considered with the child's age, behaviour, feeding, hydration and other symptoms. Very young infants and children who appear seriously unwell need prompt medical assessment.
content_hi: बच्चों के बुखार में उम्र, व्यवहार, feeding, hydration और दूसरे लक्षण देखना जरूरी है। बहुत छोटे शिशु या गंभीर रूप से बीमार दिख रहे बच्चे को जल्दी medical assessment चाहिए।
content_hinglish: Bachchon ke fever mein age, behaviour, feeding, hydration aur other symptoms important hain. Bahut chhote infant ya seriously unwell child ko jaldi doctor assessment chahiye.
safety_or_escalation_note: This source is adult fever guidance; use a dedicated pediatric guideline before production deployment for age-specific thresholds.
disclaimer: Educational information only. Not a diagnosis, treatment plan or substitute for a licensed healthcare professional.

content_en: COVID-19 and other respiratory infections can share symptoms such as fever, cough, breathlessness, fatigue, body aches, headache, sore throat, blocked nose, nausea or diarrhoea. Symptoms alone cannot distinguish them reliably.
content_hi: COVID-19 और दूसरी respiratory infections में बुखार, खांसी, सांस फूलना, थकान, बदन दर्द, सिरदर्द, गले में दर्द, नाक बंद, मतली या दस्त जैसे मिलते-जुलते लक्षण हो सकते हैं। सिर्फ लक्षणों से अंतर तय नहीं होता।
content_hinglish: COVID aur other respiratory infections mein fever, cough, breathlessness, fatigue, body ache, headache, sore throat, blocked nose ya diarrhoea ho sakta hai. Sirf symptoms se confirm nahi hota.
safety_or_escalation_note: Severe breathing difficulty, chest pain, confusion or blue/grey lips/skin requires emergency care.
disclaimer: Educational information only. Not a diagnosis, treatment plan or substitute for a licensed healthcare professional.

content_en: Cardiology focuses on evaluation and care of heart and blood-vessel conditions. Healflow may suggest Cardiology for non-emergency heart-related concerns, but symptoms such as acute chest pain must go through emergency safety handling first.
content_hi: Cardiology दिल और blood vessels से जुड़ी समस्याओं के assessment और care पर केंद्रित है। लेकिन अचानक सीने में दर्द जैसे लक्षण पहले emergency safety flow में जाएंगे।
content_hinglish: Cardiology heart aur blood vessels se related concerns ka assessment karti hai. Lekin sudden chest pain jaise symptoms pehle emergency safety flow mein jayenge.
safety_or_escalation_note: Specialty routing is not a diagnosis and does not replace emergency triage.
disclaimer: Educational information only. Not a diagnosis, treatment plan or substitute for a licensed healthcare professional.

content_en: Dermatology evaluates conditions affecting skin, hair and nails, such as persistent rashes, acne, itching, hair loss and changing moles. Sudden widespread swelling, breathing difficulty or severe systemic illness is not a routine dermatology booking.
content_hi: Dermatology त्वचा, बाल और नाखूनों की समस्याएं जैसे लगातार rash, acne, खुजली, hair loss और बदलते तिल assess करती है। सांस की परेशानी या गंभीर allergic reaction routine booking नहीं है।
content_hinglish: Dermatology skin, hair aur nails ke concerns assess karti hai—rash, acne, itching, hair loss, changing mole. Breathing issue ya severe allergy routine booking nahi hai.
safety_or_escalation_note: Use emergency handling for anaphylaxis-like symptoms such as breathing difficulty or tongue/throat swelling.
disclaimer: Educational information only. Not a diagnosis, treatment plan or substitute for a licensed healthcare professional.

content_en: Pediatrics provides medical care for infants, children and adolescents. The child's age, growth, development, feeding, immunization history and current symptoms may be relevant during assessment.
content_hi: Pediatrics शिशुओं, बच्चों और किशोरों की medical care से जुड़ी specialty है। जांच में उम्र, growth, development, feeding, vaccination history और मौजूदा लक्षण relevant हो सकते हैं।
content_hinglish: Pediatrics infants, children aur adolescents ki medical care hai. Assessment mein age, growth, development, feeding aur vaccination history useful ho sakti hai.
safety_or_escalation_note: Use pediatric-specific clinical protocols and age-based emergency rules; adult guidance must not be reused for children.
disclaimer: Educational information only. Not a diagnosis, treatment plan or substitute for a licensed healthcare professional.

content_en: Neurology evaluates disorders of the brain, spinal cord, nerves and muscles. Recurrent headaches, persistent numbness, tremor or coordination concerns may need assessment. Sudden weakness, speech difficulty or seizure requires emergency care.
content_hi: Neurology brain, spinal cord, nerves और muscles से जुड़ी समस्याएं assess करती है। बार-बार सिरदर्द, लगातार सुन्नपन, tremor या coordination की परेशानी में assessment हो सकता है। अचानक कमजोरी या बोलने में दिक्कत emergency है।
content_hinglish: Neurology brain, spinal cord, nerves aur muscles ke disorders assess karti hai. Recurrent headache, numbness, tremor ya coordination issue check ho sakta hai. Sudden weakness/speech issue emergency hai.
safety_or_escalation_note: Never route sudden stroke-like symptoms or active seizure to routine booking.
disclaimer: Educational information only. Not a diagnosis, treatment plan or substitute for a licensed healthcare professional.

content_en: Orthopedics focuses on bones, joints, ligaments, tendons and musculoskeletal injuries. Persistent joint pain, sports injuries or suspected fractures may need orthopedic assessment.
content_hi: Orthopedics हड्डियों, joints, ligaments, tendons और musculoskeletal injuries से जुड़ी specialty है। लगातार joint pain, sports injury या fracture के शक में assessment हो सकता है।
content_hinglish: Orthopedics bones, joints, ligaments, tendons aur musculoskeletal injuries se related hai. Persistent joint pain, sports injury ya fracture doubt mein assessment ho sakta hai.
safety_or_escalation_note: Severe trauma, deformity, uncontrolled bleeding, loss of sensation or circulation concerns require emergency assessment.
disclaimer: Educational information only. Not a diagnosis, treatment plan or substitute for a licensed healthcare professional.

content_en: General Medicine can provide an initial assessment for common adult health concerns, review symptoms and medical history, and decide whether tests, follow-up or a specialist referral may be appropriate.
content_hi: General Medicine आम adult health concerns का initial assessment कर सकती है, symptoms और medical history review कर सकती है और जरूरत पर tests, follow-up या specialist referral तय कर सकती है।
content_hinglish: General Medicine common adult health concerns ka initial assessment karti hai, symptoms/history review karke tests ya specialist referral suggest kar sakti hai.
safety_or_escalation_note: A general medicine recommendation must not delay emergency care.
disclaimer: Educational information only. Not a diagnosis, treatment plan or substitute for a licensed healthcare professional.

content_en: Before an appointment, note when symptoms started, where they occur, how they feel, what makes them better or worse, how often they happen, and any associated symptoms. Bring current medicines, allergies and relevant reports if available.
content_hi: Appointment से पहले लिखें कि लक्षण कब शुरू हुए, कहां हैं, कैसे महसूस होते हैं, किससे बढ़ते/कम होते हैं और कितनी बार होते हैं। मौजूदा दवाओं, allergies और reports की जानकारी साथ रखें।
content_hinglish: Appointment se pehle note karein symptoms kab start hue, kahan hain, kaise feel hote hain, kis se badhte/kam hote hain aur kitni baar hote hain. Medicines, allergies aur reports ki details le jayein.
safety_or_escalation_note: Do not ask users to stop prescribed medicines before an appointment.
disclaimer: Educational information only. Not a diagnosis, treatment plan or substitute for a licensed healthcare professional.

content_en: Useful context can include known medical conditions, previous surgeries, allergies, current medicines or supplements, pregnancy status when relevant, family history and prior test reports. Share only information relevant to the clinician's assessment.
content_hi: डॉक्टर को relevant जानकारी दें: पुरानी बीमारियां, surgery, allergies, चल रही medicines/supplements, जरूरत पड़ने पर pregnancy status, family history और पुराने test reports।
content_hinglish: Doctor ko relevant details dein: medical conditions, surgery, allergies, current medicines/supplements, relevant pregnancy status, family history aur old reports.
safety_or_escalation_note: Collect sensitive health data only with appropriate consent, access controls and privacy safeguards.
disclaimer: Educational information only. Not a diagnosis, treatment plan or substitute for a licensed healthcare professional.

content_en: Healflow AI Specialist Guide can provide general health information and suggest which available specialty may be relevant. It cannot diagnose a disease, interpret a full clinical picture, prescribe medicines or replace a licensed healthcare professional.
content_hi: Healflow AI Specialist Guide सामान्य health information दे सकता है और relevant available specialty suggest कर सकता है। यह बीमारी diagnose, prescription या doctor की जगह नहीं ले सकता।
content_hinglish: Healflow AI Specialist Guide general health info aur relevant specialty suggest kar sakta hai. Ye diagnosis, prescription ya doctor ka replacement nahi hai.
safety_or_escalation_note: Always display a clear disclaimer and escalate emergency warning signs.
disclaimer: Educational information only. Not a diagnosis, treatment plan or substitute for a licensed healthcare professional.

topic: Doctor matching: use live database only
content_en: Doctor names, specialty, fees, ratings, consultation mode and new-patient status must come from the current Healflow doctors database. The language model must never invent doctors, availability, prices or credentials.
content_hi: Doctor का नाम, specialty, fee, rating, consultation mode और new-patient status केवल Healflow database से लें। AI को doctor, availability, price या qualification invent नहीं करनी चाहिए।
content_hinglish: Doctor name, specialty, fee, rating, mode aur new-patient status Healflow database se hi lo. AI ko doctor ya availability invent nahi karni chahiye.
safety_or_escalation_note: Check is_active and accepts_new_patients before displaying a doctor; verify appointment slots separately.
disclaimer: Educational information only. Not a diagnosis, treatment plan or substitute for a licensed healthcare professional.

content_en: If the patient's concern appears to require a specialty not offered by active Healflow doctors, clearly state that no matching specialist is currently listed. Do not map the patient to an unrelated specialty just to show a doctor.
content_hi: अगर patient की समस्या के लिए Healflow में relevant specialty उपलब्ध नहीं है, तो साफ बताएं कि matching specialist listed नहीं है। केवल doctor दिखाने के लिए unrelated specialty map न करें।
content_hinglish: Agar concern ke liye Healflow mein matching specialty nahi hai, clearly bolo ki specialist listed nahi hai. Sirf doctor dikhane ke liye unrelated mapping mat karo.
safety_or_escalation_note: Offer safe general guidance and advise the user to contact an appropriate external healthcare provider.
disclaimer: Educational information only. Not a diagnosis, treatment plan or substitute for a licensed healthcare professional.

content_en: Emergency warning signs must take priority over symptom-to-specialty matching, vector retrieval results, doctor recommendations and booking actions. Stop ordinary booking flow and show concise emergency guidance.
content_hi: Emergency warning signs को specialty matching, RAG results, doctor recommendations और booking से ऊपर priority दें। सामान्य booking flow रोककर emergency guidance दिखाएं।
content_hinglish: Emergency red flags ko specialty matching, RAG results, doctor recommendation aur booking se pehle priority do. Normal booking rok kar emergency guidance dikhao.
safety_or_escalation_note: Use a clinician-reviewed red-flag checklist and local emergency instructions; do not rely only on LLM classification.
disclaimer: Educational information only. Not a diagnosis, treatment plan or substitute for a licensed healthcare professional.

content_en: The chatbot must not start, stop, change or recommend prescription medicines or doses. It may advise the user to contact their clinician or pharmacist for medication questions.
content_hi: Chatbot prescription medicine शुरू, बंद, बदलने या dose recommend नहीं करेगा। दवा से जुड़े सवालों के लिए clinician या pharmacist से संपर्क करने को कहे।
content_hinglish: Chatbot prescription medicine start, stop, change ya dose recommend nahi karega. Medicine questions ke liye clinician/pharmacist se baat karne ko kahe.
safety_or_escalation_note: Medication safety policy should be enforced in prompts and application logic, not only by retrieval content.
disclaimer: Educational information only. Not a diagnosis, treatment plan or substitute for a licensed healthcare professional.

content_en: When answering from retrieved knowledge, use only relevant source-backed content. If retrieved passages do not answer the question, say the information is insufficient and recommend professional assessment rather than guessing.
content_hi: RAG से जवाब देते समय relevant source-backed content ही use करें। Retrieved data में जवाब न हो तो guess न करें; कहें कि जानकारी पर्याप्त नहीं है और professional assessment suggest करें।
content_hinglish: RAG answer mein sirf relevant source-backed content use karo. Data mein answer na ho toh guess mat karo; insufficient info bolo aur professional assessment suggest karo.
safety_or_escalation_note: Store source title and URL with each chunk so the chatbot can show citations.
disclaimer: Educational information only. Not a diagnosis, treatment plan or substitute for a licensed healthcare professional.

content_en: Collect only information needed to respond or support booking. Avoid requesting identity numbers, passwords or unrelated sensitive details. Protect chat history with authentication, authorization and appropriate retention controls.
content_hi: सिर्फ उतनी जानकारी लें जितनी जवाब या booking के लिए जरूरी है। ID number, password या unrelated sensitive details न मांगें। Chat history को authentication और access controls से सुरक्षित रखें।
content_hinglish: Sirf required info collect karo. ID number, password ya unrelated sensitive details mat maango. Chat history ko auth aur access controls se secure rakho.
safety_or_escalation_note: Follow applicable privacy and health-data requirements before production deployment.
